speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing right groin pain and have an abnormal leg positioning after a rear-end collision. To begin my assessment, can you tell me exactly how your leg is positioned and if you heard a snap or crack at the time of the accident?

speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old female. The patient was involved in a rear-end collision where she was the restrained driver of the back car. She reports immediate onset of pain in both knees and severe pain over the right groin area following the accident.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Anterior Hip Dislocation (Right).

The mechanism of injury (rear-end collision with immediate onset of severe groin pain and abnormal positioning) combined with your age and gender is highly suggestive of an anterior hip dislocation, often associated with sciatic nerve injury. I need to confirm if your right leg is currently held in external rotation and abduction. REQUEST IMAGES: Right Hip AP X-Ray and Lateral View.
